transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today? Is there something specific you'd like to talk about?

I came in because I’ve been feeling like I’m a danger to people and just… a disappointment. There was this near-miss, and I can’t stop thinking that it proves I shouldn’t be a nurse. It feels like everyone would be better off without me.
Have you been feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things, even when it wasn’t necessarily your fault?

Yes. I keep blaming myself for that near-miss. I know maybe other people would say it doesn’t mean I’m a terrible nurse, but I can’t stop feeling like it proves I’m dangerous and a disappointment… like I shouldn’t be doing this job. It gets to the point where I think everyone would be better off without me.
Have you noticed feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even when it's not related to this situation?

Yeah… most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Even when I’m at the clinic, smiling at patients or speaking with them in Spanish and trying to seem normal, I feel like I’m barely holding myself together.
Have you found that things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with loved ones, don’t bring you any pleasure anymore?

Yeah. I used to do things to clear my head, like jogging, knitting, cooking, or reading after class. Now I’ll come home and just sit on my bed still in my scrubs, and I can’t make myself care about any of it. It just feels pointless.
Have you ever experienced a time before this where you felt this way — with the same kind of sadness, loss of interest, or guilt — or is this the first time you’ve felt like this?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember feeling it this strongly before. I’ve had bad days, of course, but this feels different… heavier. I don’t know if there was another time that was the same.
Have you felt this way for most of the day, more days than not, for at least the past two years?
Not two years, no. It’s been more like… about a year and two months. It started after I graduated high school and began college classes and working full-time at the clinic.
Have you ever had a period of time before this current one — lasting at least two weeks — where you felt down or lost interest in things, similar to how you’ve been feeling lately?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time before this that lasted that long or felt the same. I’ve had rough stretches, but nothing that clearly stands out like this.

Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, have you ever had a time — lasting at least two weeks — where you felt the same way, with similar sadness, guilt, or loss of pleasure?
I don’t think so. I can’t remember any time before this that lasted two weeks or more and felt the same. I’ve had normal sad periods, but not like this.
Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, have you ever had a time when you felt this way for at least two weeks, even if it didn’t last as long as now?
No, I don’t think I’ve had that before this. I’ve had bad days or short rough patches, but nothing that went on for two weeks where I felt like this.
Has there been a time during this past year and two months when you felt down or lost interest in things nearly every day, all day, for at least two weeks in a row?
Yes. It’s been going on pretty much this whole time — about a year and two months. It started after I graduated high school and began college classes and working full-time at the clinic.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row, even if it wasn’t as severe or long as now?
I really don’t think so. Before this, I had normal ups and downs, but I can’t remember any stretch of two weeks where I felt down or uninterested like this.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for two weeks or more, even if it wasn’t as intense or long as what you’re experiencing now?
I don’t think so. I mean, I had normal stressful times before, but not a solid two weeks or more of feeling down or not interested in things like this.

Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, have you ever had a time — lasting at least two weeks — where you felt similarly down or uninterested, even if it wasn’t as long or severe as now?
No, not that I can remember. Before this, I had normal bad days or stressful periods, but I don’t think I ever had something that lasted two weeks like this.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for two weeks or more, even if it wasn’t as intense or long as what you’re experiencing now?
No, I don’t think I have. I know I’ve had bad days before, or been stressed, but nothing I can remember that lasted two weeks or more like that.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row, even if it wasn’t as severe or long as now?
No, I really don’t think so. I’ve had rough days before, but I can’t remember any time before this where it was nearly every day for two weeks straight.

Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things nearly every day for at least two weeks in a row, even if it wasn’t as intense or long as what you’re experiencing now?
Not that I can think of. I know I’ve said this already, but before now it was more like normal stress or a bad day here and there, not something that went on nearly every day for two weeks.

Before this current period of feeling down and losing interest in things, have you ever had a time when you felt this way nearly every day for at least two weeks, followed by a period of at least a couple of months where you felt better before this current time started?

No, I don’t think so. I can’t remember having a stretch like that before this, where it was nearly every day for two weeks and then I felt better for months after. Before this, it just wasn’t like that.
